scope: Identity audit of 255 named source-sheet entries. No artwork, runtime/profile/ID edits, or canonical species count is produced.
countPolicy: A sheet entry, an official reference entity, a visual variant, an authored form ID, and an available art pack are different identities. Never deduplicate by stripping Black, Dot, mode, color, punctuation or romanization.

limits: 255 is the count of individually named sheets on the selected page, not a proven number of unique canonical species.
A verified official page does not by itself verify a historical game localization or the exact form drawn in a source sheet.
Shared URL groups are provenance collisions, not permission to merge artwork or stable gameplay IDs.
There is no defensible exact canonical-species total yet: Dot references, variant candidates and localized-name reviews prevent that claim.
133 resolved sheet IDs are unique; the other 122 IDs remain unavailable, so source-ID deduplication is incomplete.
Only Agumon, Greymon and MetalGreymon have local visual-review records; the remaining 252 named sheets were not inspected in this audit.
NPC Digimon is one uninspected grouped sheet outside the 255; its contents cannot be counted or deduplicated from its title.
Variant families are explanatory groupings of existing named entries, not canonical equivalence classes or evolution routes.
Fresh/In-Training naming and Calumon Unknown are retained separately from authored combat tiers. Armor does not become canonical Champion merely because the prototype balances it there.
No additional artwork was requested or downloaded; no blocked source-site retry, asset substitution, runtime edits or gameplay-ID merges occurred.
